description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each), grants [MAG and MND +30%, RES +25% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Desch v2)], [Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Desch v2)
